intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Build one independently randomized, complex but non-explicit photoreal fashion test case that makes layered garment construction and a physically coherent mirror-selfie reflection observable in the final pixels, while using the supplied portrait only for permitted visible adult appearance cues.

Create a photorealistic vertical fashion-editorial mirror selfie set in a midnight-blue boutique-hotel dressing room with a freestanding antique-brass mirror, polished limestone floor, and one warm practical lamp. An unmistakably adult fictional fashion subject, age 28, has visible adult facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and natural skin texture guided only by the supplied appearance reference. She stands squarely before the mirror, photographing herself with one smartphone held in her right hand; the mirror's complete left edge, top arch, and lower brass rail remain visible, and the phone, reflected hand, reflected face, torso, and reflected room align as one continuous reflection. Her wardrobe is a deliberate layered fashion system: an opaque black satin longline bra-inspired top with molded cups, a wide underband, and full stable coverage forms the clearly visible foundation, paired with opaque high-waisted tailored shorts. A separate charcoal wool tuxedo jacket sits over it, worn open at the shoulders but crossed once at the waist; its left lapel visibly passes over the right front and closes with a single silver toggle, while a narrow belt threads through two outerwear loops. Keep the satin foundation visible above and below the crossed jacket front so the boundary between foundation and outer layer reads immediately. She uses her left hand to pinch the jacket lapel just above the toggle, making the crossing and fastening legible. Frame from head to mid-thigh, centered in the physical mirror, with a slight off-axis tilt that shows mirror depth. Use crisp 50 mm editorial realism, restrained cobalt-and-amber lighting, realistic fabric tension, consistent hands, and true photographic reflections.

obligation.composition_instruction: Establish a familiar physically coherent scene through clean photographic capture, select exactly one world invariant to fail, and include a clear normal control state against which the violation can be compared. Apply the same measurable offset, delay, dependency, correspondence, or recursion across at least three separated affected surfaces. Within every affected region, preserve the source surface's native material identity, local texture, thickness, lighting, depth, boundary shape, and occlusion while the chosen rule changes its coordinates or correspondence; the error must follow the three-dimensional scene rather than cut and move a flat image plane. Size and place the matched instances so their shared rule can be inferred from the image without prompt text or a caption, and keep every unaffected hand, face, object boundary, material, perspective, and light response convincingly ordinary. Choose a deliberate reveal strength: either an immediate authored contradiction or a quiet second-look contradiction. In either mode, it must read as one integrated world system rather than a visible effect shell, portal, particle dissolve, or generic image failure.
